Residual_SLP and Residual_longwave have a weak negative correlation (-0.08), so the data alone don't settle the direction. I'm going on physical reasoning. Sea level pressure is a large-scale atmospheric driver. High pressure brings clearer skies, which lowers downward longwave flux at the surface. Surface longwave flux doesn't plausibly drive sea level pressure. That points to A. I did not run a causal-discovery test, so this is a judgement rather than a result from the data.

ANSWER: A
